scripts.worker: cd worker && uv run --env-file .env python -m verifier_worker
scripts.deploy-worker: cd worker && uv run --env-file .env python -m verifier_worker --deploy
scripts.index-docs: cd worker && uv run --env-file .env python -m verifier_worker.docs
scripts.test:worker: pnpm -C api migrate --test && cd worker && uv run pytest -q
